newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's CIB group IAS pre-tax profit HUF 11.4 bl.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's CIB group IAS pre-tax profit HUF 11.4 bl.

text.p: Hungary's CIB Bank said on Tuesday it had generated an IAS, audited and consolidated pre-tax profit of 11.4 billion forints in 1996 while its balance sheet total reached 279.2 billion forints.
The bank generated a net interest income of 12.9 billion forints, while its loans amounted to 133.5 billion forints.
"In 1996 the bank maintained the traditionally good quality of its loans," the bank said in a statement. "This means that qualified loans accounted for one percent of total assets."
The bank's capital adequacy ratio was 15.96 percent.
The bank said it continued to expand its branch network and by adding three new offices in Miskolc, Kecskemet and Zalaegerszeg cities, increased the number of branches to 12 in 1996.
This year CIB plans to open three new offices in Szombathely, Dunaujvaros and Kaposvar cities.
The bank added that its biggest shareholder, the National Bank of Hungary (NBH) would sell its whole 34 percent stake this year.
The other owners have pre-emptive rights to buy the NBH's shares, CIB said.
The bank said that it would merge with its subsidiary, CIB Hungaria Bank Rt, probably at the end of this year.
